zone_data_ref.note: region chunks currently use Crosshaven stand-in ids; see zone_id_map.standin_terrain and props[].standin_crosshaven

files.masters: 2x PNG at <kind>/_2x/<id>.png, draw at scale 0.5 (identical placement)

anchors.tile: image bottom-centre on the cell diamond SOUTH tip (board/tile.gd): draw at cell_to_local(cell, elev) + (-w/2, 16 - h). Floor/decal tiles are 64x32, so the image IS the diamond.
anchors.side_strip: 32x26 strip per height step k (0 = just under the top): left face top-left = south_tip + (-32, -16 + 10k), right face top-left = south_tip + (0, -16 + 10k); south_tip of the LIFTED tile. Optional upgrade over painted placeholder faces.
anchors.prop: image bottom-centre on the SOUTH tip of the footprint's south-most cell (max x+y; for 2x2 = origin+(1,1)), lifted by that cell's height: draw at cell_to_local(south_cell, elev) + (0,16) + (-w/2, -h). NW origin only defines the covered cells.
anchors.y_sort: sort by the footprint south-most cell (x+y). If you use a y-sort point instead, use image bottom - 16 px (centre of the south-most cell) and break ties in favour of characters.

standin_terrain.water: (glossy_ice is walkable; do not map water to it without a walkability decision)

zone_id_map.note: zone data keeps its ids; the placer / dressing.json picks these pieces per cell (Crosshaven hash picker)

fence_axis.along_y: fence_wood_nesw: rail runs along +y, screen up-right to down-left

wp10a.palette_status: PROPOSED: the spec gives no Windmere hexes; snow/ice/stone sampled from art/maps/arena_colosseum_v2/tiled/windmere_15x15_painted_preview.png (pc/world-zones), pine and lantern added

processing.pipeline: scratch/wp10a: wp10a_props.py (key + decontaminate on the flat bg, 8x supersampled place, area downsample to 2x and 1x), rv_fix.py (painted-shadow removal behind the dark outline, palette nudge 30% capped at 7 dE, per-asset retouch), wp10a_tiles.py (--fix-seams, --edges), wp10a_sails.py, wp10a_atlas.py; driver rv_run.py

white_flagstone.seam_note: exact period crop (635.5x407.75 px, phase chosen for the lowest wrap seam) resampled anisotropically to 1024x1024 (stones 1.56x longer along world y); variants are value-wobble only (a shifted-copy blend would ghost the joints)
